mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Verona City Hall with an actual temperature of 82 degrees and a heat index making it feel like 90.

The city has two major updates today. Phase two of utility and road construction on Highway M starts the week of September 7, bringing traffic shifts and lane changes. Additionally, the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture is now on display at Century School Park, showcasing a beautiful wood carving inspired by traditional movements.

There is plenty to do in town with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee both taking place today. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow, or check out yoga at Insight Wellness on September 7.
In our weekly look at noteworthy calls, on August 30, a vehicle versus bicyclist crash occurred at East Verona Avenue and Lincoln Street, resulting in a citation for the driver.
You can enjoy today's flavor, Chocolate Volcano, at the Verona location. They are currently open and will be serving up scoops until they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
